recipe.criteria: Standing unilateral cable knee curl, left foot on step, right ankle cuff attached to a low front pulley. Hands hold frame, torso fixed, knees 180 to 80 degrees; four seconds each direction. Stack follows cable extension.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
